title: Source API for finite-dimensional proper coherent cohomology
statement: Let k be a field, X a scheme over k with proper structure morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and F a quasi-coherent finitely presented O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For every q in N its source-library module cohomology H^q(X,F), with the scalar action through the given structure map [pqf-def-cohomology], is finite dimensional over k [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. No smoothness, connectedness, projectivity, or nonemptiness is required. This records the field-valued finiteness API already proved in the source library; it omits the extra bounded-vanishing conclusion of lem-pc-euler-characteristic-well-defined.

source.place: Tag 02O5, proper coherent finiteness, field base; existing proof finiteDimensional_H_of_isProper in WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Cohomology/DirectImage/AffineMorphism.lean

proof.text: Apply proper coherent finiteness over the Noetherian affine scheme Spec k: the higher direct image has a finite module of global sections. The source proof uses finite_sections_higherDirectImage.

The affine-base comparison identifies those sections with H^q(X,F). The field-valued comparison is semilinear for the scalar isomorphism Gamma(Spec k,O)=k. Transport a finite generating set across that bijective semilinear map; every scalar in Gamma(Spec k,O) comes from k, so its image spans H^q(X,F) over k. This is finiteDimensional_H_of_isProper in AffineMorphism. The zero scheme and zero sheaf give zero-dimensional groups.
